design.status: Infilled panel screws on six 2x6 principals — NOT build-ready
design.description: 151 ordinary panel/kicker screws, including 71 new infill screws. Intervals are at most 150 mm between existing first and last screws on each panel along all six interior principals; panel end distances remain unchanged. Six independent interior 2x6 principals retain aligned single 2x10 posts; two separated center principals leave a 101.9 mm service corridor and 50.95 mm unsupported plywood edges at the vertical joint. The horizontal seam remains unsupported between principals. Ordinary panel screws remain. Through-bolt heads, nuts and both washers are separate selectable geometry. No previous strength or floor qualification transfers to this layout.
